sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module is designed to allow the student to: work on a collaborative project with students from other disciplines within the university, or with external partners. manage their relationship between project partner(s) and client(s). negotiate a senior role within a collaborative project and cement their knowledge of filmmaking craft by completing a project using a high skills base. work to advanced safe and healthy practices. reflect on their role within the project and offer a clear and concise evaluation of their skills.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate a professional level of technical competence in a specialist area to realise a short project. B Demonstrate the ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively whilst managing their own and others’ time within a project based environment. C Deliver an advanced level of creative output in a specialist role to allow the completion of a short project. D Effectively synthesize ideas to generate solutions within a collaborative environment. E Critically evaluate practice by placing it in a reflective framework.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components (Lectures and mentoring). A short series of lectures will provide the understanding of collaboration and project management. Tutorials will focus on project management, creative decision making. Seminars will focus on reviewing work in progress.
